usage: Used for volcanic lava; this is a high-frequency science/geography noun.
Most often appears in formal or factual writing, news, documentaries, and school science contexts.
Can pair with words about volcanoes, heat, flow, solidifying, and eruption; it is not a casual everyday word.
When talking about a volcano, this noun refers to the hot molten rock on or near the Earth’s surface; for deep underground molten rock, another term is often used.
